residual_risks: Georgia's expectations do not detect S3: only its exact baseline does (blind spot georgia-resupply).
The resupply-chain check stays green on the mutant although every delivery is fuel (blind spot unobservable-supply).
Nothing to roll back: windows-retail v1 stays current and unchanged.
decision: Rejected. The candidate reintroduces the defect S3 corrects; it stays failing and never advances the baseline. It is a test-only mutant (tools/build-mutant-windows.sh), never a product candidate; the accepted build keeps S3. Accepting it would need an explicitly different future decision.
review: This record is reviewed in the PR that adds it. A regression is rejected without an approval: it changes no baseline.
